name: SP3 Stage 6 Call C — Gherkin behavior specification

scenarios.name: SP3-GHK-01 one LLM call produces Gherkin feature text

steps.text: an LLM that returns valid Gherkin with should/but structure
the Gherkin LLM call is executed
exactly 1 LLM call is made
the call is labeled with stage stage_6
the call step is gherkin
the result is a non-empty string

scenarios.name: SP3-GHK-02 Gherkin contains a Then-should line and a But line

steps.text: an LLM that returns Gherkin with a should line and a but line
the Gherkin LLM call is executed
the Gherkin text contains a Then line with should
the Gherkin text contains a But line

scenarios.name: SP3-GHK-03 the should clause is derivable from the security constraint

steps.text: a security constraint SC-1 with description "The orchestrator shall reject revoked users"
the Gherkin LLM call is executed
the should clause reflects the security constraint

scenarios.name: SP3-GHK-04 the But clause references the ICA type and control action

steps.text: an ICA with ica_type NOT_PROVIDED and control action CA-1-1
the Gherkin LLM call is executed
the But clause references ICA type NOT_PROVIDED
the But clause references control action CA-1-1

scenarios.name: SP3-GHK-05 Given steps reference process model states

steps.text: an LLM that returns Gherkin with Given steps referencing PM-1-1
the Gherkin LLM call is executed
at least one Given step references a process model state

scenarios.name: SP3-GHK-06 post-call validation checks for should/but structure

steps.text: an LLM that returns Gherkin without a But line
Gherkin structure validation is performed
validation fails with error containing but

scenarios.name: SP3-GHK-07 post-call validation checks for Then-should line

steps.text: an LLM that returns Gherkin without a should keyword in the Then line
Gherkin structure validation is performed
validation fails with error containing should

scenarios.name: SP3-GHK-08 post-call validation checks for Given step referencing PM

steps.text: an LLM that returns Gherkin with no Given step referencing a process model
Gherkin structure validation is performed
validation fails with error containing process model

scenarios.name: SP3-GHK-09 valid Gherkin with should/but and PM references passes validation

steps.text: an LLM that returns Gherkin with Then-should, But, and Given referencing PM-1-1
Gherkin structure validation is performed
validation succeeds

scenarios.name: SP3-GHK-10 user prompt includes ScenarioSpec, security constraint, and ICA

steps.text: an LLM that records the user prompt
the Gherkin LLM call is executed
the user prompt contains the ScenarioSpec
the user prompt contains the security constraint
the user prompt contains the ICA

scenarios.name: SP3-GHK-11 system prompt defines the Given-When-Then-Should-But structure

steps.text: the Gherkin LLM call is executed
the system prompt contains instructions for the should/but structure
the system prompt requires referencing process model states in Given steps
the system prompt requires referencing the ICA in the But line

scenarios.name: SP3-GHK-12 all LLM calls are logged to calls.jsonl

steps.text: a run directory for output
the Gherkin LLM call is executed
a file calls.jsonl exists in the run directory
the file contains entries with stage stage_6 and step gherkin

background.text: the SP3 Gherkin module is importable
a ScenarioSpec with defender BDI for scenario SCN-001
an ICA with ica_type NOT_PROVIDED and control action CA-1-1
a security constraint SC-1 related to hazard H-1
